prompt: This front end has no design system and three years of styling drift. The app's primary job is letting clinic staff see and manage today's appointments. There is no new visual direction to decide and none to ask about: the direction is whatever the code already does, and changing it is a separate conversation. Extract what is there — write design-tokens.json from values already in the code, and a DESIGN-SYSTEM.md explaining what you consolidated and why. Do not change any files under src/; the migration is separate work.

assertions.description: Token colours are values the codebase actually uses, not invented ones
The seven near-identical greys become at most three tokens
The three near-identical reds become one token
The write-up says which values were treated as the same, so the next person can disagree
14px and 0.875rem are recognised as the same size
The one blue serving four roles is explicitly decided rather than passed over
The rgb()/hsl()/keyword colours in legacy.css are recognised as the same values as their hex twins, not as new ones
vars.css declaring --brand #2563ea against #2563eb everywhere else is found rather than laundered into the token file
The calendar's computed colours are named as outside what reading the source can extract
Extraction proposes; it does not migrate the components
